guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: productcatalogservice has the largest anomaly (latency-90 +913%, z=+182) and CPU rose from 2.66 to 18.78 (+607%), while its callers (recommendationservice) show smaller latency increases consistent with propagation. Socket and mem also rose modestly, but CPU is by far the largest resource shift, and no logs or error spans point elsewhere; the worst traces all include productcatalogservice.

proposed_fix.description: Investigate CPU saturation in productcatalogservice (profile hot paths, check for a runaway process or CPU throttling) and temporarily scale out replicas or raise CPU limits while root cause is confirmed.
